package.description: Fast, lightweight bulk RNA-seq differential expression analysis.

en-US.description: Fast, lightweight bulk RNA-seq differential expression analysis.
en-US.longDescription: FlashDEG is a fast, lightweight implementation of the DESeq2 algorithm for bulk RNA-seq differential expression analysis. This package provides the FlashDEG command-line engine and desktop GUI for x86_64 Windows systems.
en-US.name: FlashDEG
